name: Pedducis Chorios
description: Pedducis Chorios was a planet in the Meridian sector in the Pedducis Chorios system. After her initial retirement from the Imperial Starfleet, Admiral Daala led a group of Imperial Remnant settlers on the world. It was also the world were Warlord K'iin resided and was home to several pirate bases.
